notes.title: Football Manager 2021's final winter update is out now
notes.content:
All editions of Football Manager 2021 should now have the final winter update available for install. The latest patch for the reigning king of digital football games addresses a few outstanding bugs and includes updates to the database and reflects transfers made during windows that closed in February.

If you begin a new career now, you'll see that deals in China, Russia, Major League Soccer, and free transfers in the English Football League have been reflected in the update. Sports Interactive helpfully suggests that this means "there's never been a better time to take your managerial skills abroad," which for me means it's time to check back in on my NYCFC squad.

Sports Interactive has also patched out a few bugs, although some players are frustrated that the developer hasn't yet addressed particular issues they've found. The company has been wary about making too many changes to the Match Engine in this update, telling users on the Football Manager community forums that "it'd be far too risky for us to do so for an update of this kind." The most significant Match Engine tweak this time around is a fix for throw-ins.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Football Manager Final Winter Update Now Live
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38803033/4c16e16b455cfc9b6e6f63d266cf93b5a60a6a19.png[/img]

The Final Winter Update for Football Manager 2021 is now complete, with this second part covering transfers from windows that closed during February, database updates and a few outstanding gameplay fixes.

Deals that happened in China, Russia, MLS, as well as free transfers in the EFL are included in this Update. You’ll need to begin a new career for them to take effect, so there’s never been a better time to take your managerial skills abroad. 

A gameplay patch containing fixes and improvements across multiple areas of the game is also included in this Update which are save game compatible. 

The Update should download automatically but if you find that it hasn’t installed, quit and restart Steam.

Gameplay fixes for Update 21.4 include (but are not limited to): 
•	A fix for crashes that were occurring when users entered matches
•	General in-game stability fixes
•	Better tracking of the chances which should be considered as ‘clear-cut’
•	Ensuring passing combinations appear correctly on chalkboards/stats menus
•	Most assists by a player within club records now appearing correctly

notes.title: Football Manager 2021's main winter update is out now
notes.content:
Football Manager 2021's main winter update is available now, and it brings with it more than 3.7 million database changes that reflect up-to-date information on players' performance through this season so far. The update also includes some improvements and fixes to the game, addressing some of the weird little annoyances you may have encountered in the football game.

The database changes cover things like real-world transfers, managerial changes, and player stats that have changed over the course of the current season. You'll have to start a new career in order to see those data changes and competition updates in your game, but the rest of the improvements in the patch are compatible with your current saves.

Sports Interactive has made some changes to the logic governing Club Vision and manager appointments, and has addressed some issues with incorrect (and puzzling) questions being asked during press conferences that don't correspond with the results of the latest match. The match engine has seen some tweaks, including improvements to goalkeeper distribution and assistant advice during the pre-game build up and matches.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Football Manager Main Winter Update Now Live
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38803033/2fec5b97a882c503d08609d2f5783cad8bb7d76d.png[/img]

The Main Winter Update for FM21 (PC/Mac) is available now, with this part including updated squads following the January transfer window. 

The Final Winter Update will follow in a few weeks, covering the latest deals from transfer windows that closed in February, including the Chinese and Russian leagues, MLS, free transfers in the EFL and more.

More than 3.7m database changes feature in the Main Winter Update update and among them are tweaks to player data to reflect their real-world performances so far this season.

This first update also includes a gameplay patch that contains fixes and improvements across a number of areas in the game. 

The gameplay patch will take effect in all current save games, but you will need to begin a new career for the data changes and competition updates to appear.

Most updates like this should download automatically but if that isn’t the case, you’ll just need to quit and restart the Epic Games launcher or Steam. 

[b]Changes in the 21.3 update include (but are not limited to):[/b]

-	Number of stability fixes and improvements
-	Further improvements to total player count and number of newgens generated in youth intakes
-	Re-enabled option to ask board for Reserve/U23 team
-	Improvements to staff given non-playing staff appointment responsibilities
-	Further balancing of player ratings across both full and quick match engines
-	Number of improvements and fixes to match stats, including key tackles, clear-cut chances and interceptions 
-	Improved goalkeeper distribution when set tactically via instructions
-	Added assist details to the goal caption in matches

A more detailed changelist is available through our [url=https://community.sigames.com/forums/topic/548954-football-manager-213-main-winter-update-out-now/]community forums[/url]. 

The Main Winter Update is also now live on FM21 Mobile (iOS/Android) and FM21 Touch (PC/Mac/iOS/Android), and will be coming to FM21 Xbox and FM21 Touch for Nintendo Switch™ in the near future.

notes.title: Football Manager 2021 21.2.2 Minor Update Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38803033/a651bc49bb79f2420d45243cb56833e4f473b961.png[/img]

We’ve just released Minor Update 21.2.2 for Football Manager 2021 which is now available to download via Epic and Steam and as always is save game compatible. 

Updates will be downloaded automatically, but if you find for whatever reason you’re having difficulties doing so, we’d recommend restarting Epic or Steam. 

For users playing Football Manager 2021 Touch, 21.2.2 is also available across PC, Mac, Android and iOS. 

We’d like to take this opportunity to thank anyone who has taken the time to leave us feedback or raise issues to us via our forums and our support team. 

[b]Minor Update 21.2.2 (includes but not limited to):[/b]
----------------------------------------------------------
Stability and Technical
- Performance improvements related to upscaling on high resolution displays
- Fix for change resolution confirmation popup not working correctly

Gameplay
- Addressed players not staying in senior squad when being moved from other squads

Match Engine 21.5.0
- Tweaks to address player ratings being too low

Competitions and Rule Groups
- Retroactive fix for multiple home or away matches against same team in English Premier Division
- Retroactive fix for Israeli squad numbers being reset
- Fix for some foreign players being incorrectly counted as naturalised players in China
- Improvements to AI logic on foreign player registration in China
- User no longer being told they are maxing out loaning total incorrectly

Football Manager Touch Specific
- Fix for crash occurring when transfer window opens
- Importing of FM exported teams into Football Manager Touch for versus mode now working correctly

If you encounter any problems following this update, please check our FAQ - https://fm21.info/support-FAQ for solutions or create a support ticket - https://fm21.info/support-ticket.

Thanks.

notes.title: Football Manager 21.2 Major Update Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38803033/851eff4d35dd4dbbed579bec1fadfb054692587f.png[/img]

Whilst the weather outside is frightful, staying indoors to play Football Manager is starting to look even more delightful, and what better way to enjoy than with the 21.2 major update? Containing a number of tweaks, improvements and fixes as listed in our changelist below, the update is save game compatible allowing you to continue your pre-existing saves. 

That’s not all though, we’re also pleased to announce the release of updates for Football Manager 2021 Touch across PC/Mac/Android and iOS and Football Manager Xbox Edition available exclusively on the [url=https://www.footballmanager.com/games/football-manager-2021-xbox]Xbox platforms[/url]. 

If you encounter any kind of issues when running the game, we’d recommend reading our [url=https://fm21.info/support-FAQ]FAQ[/url] for troubleshooting help. You can also [url=https://fm21.info/support-ticket]contact our team[/url] directly for further support via our ticketing system.

On behalf of everyone here at Sports Interactive as we come to the end of 2020, we very much hope you stay safe, enjoy the holiday period and perhaps even get your team’s name carved into a few trophies along the way.  

[b]21.2 Major Update Changelist (including, but not limited to)[/b]
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]Stability and Technical[/b]
- Further changes to issues related to blurry text and mouse-cursor appearing misaligned
- Re-added options to change resolution settings in full screen mode
- Number of stability improvements

[b]Gameplay[/b]
- Unable to set some staff members to certain responsibilities
- Board incorrectly blocking deals due to wanting vast fees for players
- Recalculating how analysts produce their overall report ratings 
- Staff missing from coaching assignment list for relevant squads
- Further improvements to inactive leagues generating newgens

[b]Match Engine 21.4.0[/b]
- Better clearances
- Attackers attacking area/far post better
- Better balancing to defenders challenging for aerial balls
- Defenders marking too literally tweaks
- Move to offer passing options improvements
- Passing focus fix to long lateral passes
- Some improvements to aerial interceptions for defenders
- Sent assistant referees on training course to remove some overzealous offsides being given and sort positioning during penalties

[b]Competitions and Rule Groups[/b]*
- Various rule updates for Croatia, Serbia, Singapore, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Brazil, Uruguay, Romania, Russia and Scotland
- Spanish and Portuguese B-Team promotion fixes
- Fix for B teams incorrectly appearing in the Italian Cup
- Copa America originally scheduled for 2020 will now be played in 2021.

[b]User Interface[/b]
- Can't proceed into a match if pressing back on Team Selection panel when managing international side
- Changing manager appearance from the Start Screen does not remember any changes

For a more detailed list of changes including for the Match Engine and game editors, please visit our [url=https://community.sigames.com/topic/543513-this-is-not-a-drill/]Community forum[/url]. 

[i]*In some instances, changes to competitions, rules and registrations will require starting a new game to come into effect.
[/i]
